units.source_text: ……我们坐在褪了色并被蚕食了的杜鹃花的花用下。

en.t: ...We sat beneath the faded, insect-eaten azalea blossoms.

units.source_text: 我不明白房东姑娘为什么会愿意这样陪着我。

en.t: I could not understand why the landlady's daughter was willing to keep me company like this.

units.source_text: 我对自已故意使用了残酷的表现，可我不明白这姑娘为什么会被一股要"玷污"自身的冲动所驱使呢？

en.t: I deliberately used cruel words about myself, but I could not understand why this girl was driven by an impulse to "defile" herself.

units.source_text: 人世间也可能有羞耻和充满亲切的无抵抗，但是姑娘却一味将我的手放在她的微胖的小手上，就像落满在午睡者身上的苍蝇一样。

en.t: There may be in this world a kind of nonresistance full of shame and kindness, but the girl simply kept placing my hand on her slightly plump little hand, like flies settling all over someone taking an afternoon nap.
